## Checklist

- [ ] Commits carry a sign-off — use `git commit -s` (DCO; CI enforces it)
- [ ] One concern per PR
- [ ] I have read `CONTRIBUTING.md`
- [ ] If this changes the **`.folder-nature` schema**, the **CLI surface**, or the **mark/signing layer**: I opened an issue first
- [ ] If this changes the **version**: `pyproject.toml` and the intended tag agree — the version and the tag are the same claim stated twice
- [ ] If this touches the **README**: links are absolute, because PyPI renders that file
- [ ] If this changes **`verify --root`**: I added a case that fails against the old behavior first
